This notebook builds the orthogroup-GO annotation package used by **Fig. 3d / Extended Data Fig. 7**.

# Load required packages

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# Read orthofinder_term2gene.csv

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

machine <- "home"   # "home" or "lab"

if (machine == "home") {
  file <- "F:\\GitHub_mine\\GenomeBio\\HybridCells_Paper\\Fig5_Dosage compensation and Transcriptome\\orthofinder_term2gene.csv"
} else if (machine == "lab") {
  file <- "H:\\HybridCells_Data\\Fig3_Dosage and Transcriptome\\orthofinder_term2gene.csv"
} else {
  stop("machine must be either 'home' or 'lab'")
}
orthogroup_go <- fread(file)

```

Make a long table

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

orthogroup_go_long <- orthogroup_go %>%
  filter(!is.na(GO_union_all), GO_union_all != "") %>%
  separate_rows(GO_union_all, sep = ",") %>%
  rename(GO = GO_union_all) %>%
  distinct(Orthogroup, GO) %>%              # Deduplicate
  filter(!is.na(GO), GO != "", GO != "-")    # drop empty / "-"
```

# Prepare data frames

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

fGO <- orthogroup_go_long %>%
  distinct(Orthogroup, GO) %>%          # Deduplicate
  transmute(
    GID = Orthogroup,
    GO = GO,
    EVIDENCE = "eggnog"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

fSym <- orthogroup_go_long %>%
  distinct(Orthogroup) %>%              # Keep each OG only once
  transmute(
    GID = Orthogroup,
    SYMBOL = Orthogroup,
    GENENAME = Orthogroup
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

fChr <- orthogroup_go_long %>%
  distinct(Orthogroup) %>%
  transmute(
    GID = Orthogroup,
    CHROMOSOME = "NO"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Check
stopifnot(
  !any(duplicated(fGO)),
  !any(duplicated(fSym)),
  !any(duplicated(fChr))
)

str(fGO)
str(fSym)
str(fChr)

```
